title: 第十七章 双国斗第十八章 争斗隐秘
lines: 雷涅望向远处那……带着让人感到难以抵御的压迫之势，覆压袭来的修士洪流。
其全身气息因心中涌起的戒备，不断的攀升，从而溢散而开。
眼中那本就透露出凝重之意的神情，也是随之愈发加剧起来，直至转为阴沉之色。
而当乾峰国的修士洪流所凝汇而出的骇人压迫，达到天玄国群修所能承受的临界之点时。
洪流终是于骤然间降落而下，与包括雷涅在内的天玄国群修，撼然相对。
一股水火相抵的对冲之意，自双方人马阵前汇集之处，冲撞凝压而出。
于瞬息，震荡扩散于此方天地之间！
然而……
虽然双方人马于此刻，都是显露出骇人心神的滔天阵仗。
可若是仔细感应，便会察觉到，天玄国众修溢散而出的阵势，竟然略处下风。
相较于乾峰国的压迫，成防守之姿。
想来应该是乾峰国群修在遁落此地时，展露出的那种，于急动急静间的遁停转换，让得天玄国众修，皆是自心底涌出一股莫名震动。
心神失守下，自然在接下来的声威对冲上，被乾峰国群修的庞然之势压下了一头。
感受到天玄国众修的气势正逐渐的低迷，若是再放纵下去，恐对接下来的血炼夺宝大受影响。
雷涅身旁的那位灵老头直接纵身跃起，悬定于十余丈高的空中，微一扭首，双目随之扫视着不远处的乾峰国群修，眼里竟是淡漠之意。
紧随其后的，便是六派各宗的长老，遁起矗立在了灵老头身侧，神情间涌动着的，皆是与前者一模一样的漠然之意。
而雷涅与那魔渊门的冥陆老怪，一个在略做迟疑，思索过后，另一个则是眼神森冷的斜撇了前者一眼，都是最终自原地飞遁而起，加入到了上方七人的阵列之中。
一股属于高阶修士独有的强大压迫，自此一刻震荡而开，让得下方天玄国群修的士气，于猛然间拔升而起。
并顺着九名处于开真化层次的修士，所凝汇而出的威压之势，一并向对面乾峰国群修此时所处的阵列之处，覆压而去。
可当此等能将人骇的亡魂皆冒的滔天威势，以亘古凶灵之姿，欲要将乾峰国群修的神识彻底侵蚀磨灭时。
七道身上散发而出的气息，同样是不弱于雷涅九人的修士，于刹那间，闪掠而出。
一股庞然劲气自七名修士身上席卷而开，与自前方袭掠而来的那股滔天威势撼然相撞。
只一刻……
此间所有的修士都是感应到，一种令人感到窒息的可怖波动，于虚空无形间爆发而开！
似是错觉般，恍惚中，天地间的光线都是变的暗沉了一分！
即便过了许久，情况也没有得到丝毫的改观！
寂静成为了引导此刻天地间局面的唯一准则！
直到……
乾峰国出现的七名高阶修士中的一名黑袍青年，牙齿轻碰间，传出了一到并不算响亮的淡漠言语。
打破了此间，这仿佛会延习亘古的诡异境地！
“不知几位此番举动是何用意？！”
“是何用意？！”
“你们乾峰国的心思早就摆在明面上了，还反过来质问我等几人，不觉得很是好笑吗？！”
回答黑袍青年问话之人，正是那化圣门的灵老头，此刻其脸上早就没了与雷涅此前交谈时，那般云淡风轻之意。
取而代之的，是满脸的愠怒，以及隐藏在极深处的一股森冷杀意。
“呵呵，你们天玄国的修士行事颇为散漫，被震慑住也是活该。”
content_en:
Rene looked at the torrent of monks in the distance that was suppressing the incoming monks with an overwhelming force of oppression.
The aura in his body continued to rise due to the alertness rising in his heart, and then overflowed.
The solemn expression in his eyes gradually intensified until it turned into a gloomy look.
And when the terrifying oppression from the torrent of monks from the Qianfeng Kingdom reached the critical point that the cultivators from the Tianxuan Kingdom could bear.
The torrent finally descended suddenly, facing the group of cultivators from the Tianxuan Kingdom, including Reine, in shock.
A conflict of water and fire came out from the place where the troops from both sides gathered in front of the formation.
In an instant, the shock spread between the heaven and the earth!
However...
Although both sides of the army were at this moment, they were displaying a terrifying array of emotions.
But if you sense it carefully, you will notice that the formation of cultivators from the Tianxuan Kingdom is actually at a slight disadvantage.
Compared with the oppression of Qianfeng Kingdom, it became a defensive posture.
It seems that it should be the kind that the cultivators from the Qianfeng Kingdom showed when they fled here. The transition between rapid movement and silence made the cultivators from the Tianxuan Kingdom feel an inexplicable shock from the bottom of their hearts.
With his mind lost, he was naturally overwhelmed by the enormity of the cultivators from the Qianfeng Kingdom in the ensuing confrontation of reputation.
I feel that the momentum of the cultivators in Tianxuan Kingdom is gradually declining. If they continue to indulge, it may have a great impact on the subsequent blood refining treasure hunt.
The old man Ling next to Rennie jumped up and hung more than ten feet high in the air. He turned his head slightly and scanned the Qianfeng Kingdom cultivators not far away, with a look of indifference in his eyes.
Following closely behind were the elders of each of the six sects, who stood beside Old Ling, their expressions surging with the same indifference as the former.
As for Rene and the old monster from the Underworld of the Demonic Abyss Gate, one hesitated for a moment, and after thinking about it, the other glanced at the former with a cold look, and both finally flew up from where they were and joined the array of seven people above.
A powerful oppression unique to high-level monks began to shake at this moment, causing the morale of the cultivators in the Tianxuan Kingdom below to rise suddenly.
And following the coercive force of the nine monks who were at the level of enlightenment, they rushed towards the opposite array where the Qianfeng Kingdom cultivators were at this time, overpowering them.
But when such a powerful force that can scare the souls of the dead, in the form of an eternal evil spirit, wants to completely erode and obliterate the spiritual consciousness of the cultivators in the Qianfeng Kingdom.
The aura emanating from Qidao's body was also that of monks who were not weaker than the nine Rennie people, and they flashed out in an instant.
A huge force of energy swept away from the seven monks, and collided with the overwhelming power that attacked from the front.
Just a moment...
All the monks here sensed a suffocating and terrifying wave erupting invisibly in the void!
Like an illusion, in a trance, the light between heaven and earth became a little darker!
Even after a long time, the situation has not changed at all!
Silence has become the only criterion guiding the situation between heaven and earth at this moment!
Until...
One of the seven high-level monks who appeared in Qianfeng Kingdom, a young man in black robes, spoke indifferent words that were not loud when his teeth touched lightly.
Breaking this place, this seems to be an extension of the eternal weird situation!
"I wonder what the intentions of these actions are?"
"What's the purpose?!"
"You, Qian Fengguo, have already made it clear what you are thinking, and yet you are questioning me and a few others. Don't you think it's funny?!"
The person who answered the black-robed young man's question was none other than the old man Ling from the Holy Transformation Sect. At this moment, his face had long lost the calmness that had characterized his previous conversation with Rene.
Instead, there was a look of sullenness on his face, and a cold and murderous intention hidden deep inside.
"Haha, you monks from Tianxuan Kingdom are quite lax in your behavior, so you deserve to be frightened."
